title: 我为什么用 Fedora Server 做 NAS 系统
content: The author uses Fedora Server 44 as their NAS system because it aligns with their personal storage philosophy: no RAID redundancy, relying instead on full backups for irreplaceable data and keeping only indexes for replaceable content. They migrated from Windows Server 2025 in 2026, converting four data drives from NTFS to XFS after encountering Linux NTFS driver limitations. The system runs 14 containers via Podman (mostly rootless), provides Samba shares, and uses Xray tunnel plus frp for zero-exposure remote access without public ports. Key reasons for choosing Fedora Server include faster kernel updates, native Podman integration, SELinux enforcing by default, Cockpit management, and clean server edition without desktop bloat. The author emphasizes this path requires Linux proficiency, disciplined backup habits, and comfort with self-maintenance rather than vendor support.

title: 对英伟达5000亿美元融资的思考
content:
Nvidia's $500 billion AI infrastructure financing partnership with six major financial institutions triggered a nearly 3% stock drop and rising CDS spreads, despite appearing bullish. Markets fear circular financing risks—where Nvidia-funded entities buy its hardware—echoing historical bubbles like 1990s telecom. CEO Jensen Huang defended the plan as true third-party investment, citing rising H100 rental rates as proof of durable asset value.

Intel's concurrent $15 billion equity issuance, its first since 1971, fell over 4%. Investors interpreted the timing near all-time highs as management signaling overvaluation, outweighing AI investment rationales.

Both cases reflect market skepticism toward AI capital deployment. Hardware demand legitimacy now hinges on sustainable customer cash flows rather than narrative-driven expansion, as investors scrutinize financial engineering risks across the AI supply chain.

title: Using the GitHub Copilot SDK for Java
content: The GitHub Copilot SDK for Java provides a framework-agnostic, vendor-neutral way to integrate AI into server-side Java applications. It supports BYOK (bring your own key) for direct use with OpenAI, Azure, Anthropic, or compatible endpoints without requiring a Copilot subscription. The SDK uses familiar Java patterns: CompletableFuture, annotations, lambdas, and virtual threads. Developers define tools via `@CopilotTool` annotations, inline lambdas, or JSON Schema; customize system messages; and execute agentic loops with `sendAndWait()`. A sample Jakarta EE 11 real-estate application demonstrates features including real-time WebSocket updates, CDI integration, managed virtual threads, and fine-grained tool access control.

title: 如何评价 Anthropic 宣布将黎曼猜想的已知下界从 41.6% 提高到了 67.2%？

While attempting to solve the Riemann Hypothesis, Claude devised a new argument showing that at least 67.2% of non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function lie on the critical line.
